settings.title: Crafted in the Hours After Dreams
settings.text: Behind the initials AD Perfumes lies our quiet philosophy: After Dreams. True luxury is born at the boundary where nocturnal reverie dissolves into daylight, leaving behind sensory memories that cannot be spoken, only worn. Every Extrait de Parfum is distilled to capture that fleeting perfection.
ADDICTED is pure hypnosis. That smoky saffron and oud dry-down lasts a full 24 hours on my skin and coat. AD Perfumes has created an instant icon.
settings.name: Sophia Laurent

settings.text: Ice of Heaven has the cleanest, most invigorating glacial aquatic opening I have ever smelled. Crisp, icy, and draws compliments everywhere.
settings.name: Alexander Vance

settings.text: Rouge Elite feels like warm liquid gold. The caramelized amber and cedarwood aura is rich, decadent, and impossible to forget.
settings.name: Elena Rostova
